translation.name: Wakʉ Itekare: Emenna' Pe Ekonekan Nɨto'

content: Temari'masan Kena Po
Asa'rɨ wʉi tʉpo moro temari'masan esi'pʉ Kena po, Kiyarari airɨ. Mɨrɨ yau, Sises san esi'pʉ.
Sises mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ ipoitorʉ ton kɨ'masa' to' uya esi'pʉ mɨrɨ pona.
To' yuku, waain u'ma'sa' a'tai, isan uya, “To' yuku, waain u'matʉ'pʉ man,” ta'pʉ ipɨ'.
Sises uya eikʉ'pʉ, “Mɨrɨ iku'kɨ kʉkai upɨ', ma'non. Uweyu e'seposa' pʉra rɨ marɨ man,” tukai'.
Isan uya nin si ta'pʉ mɨrɨ to' poitorʉ ton pɨ', “Mɨrɨ iku'tɨ' ta iya mʉku'tʉi',” ta'pʉ iya.
Esuwerʉ amʉ' eseru esi'pʉ ekorʉkan tawon, mɨrɨ to' nin si 6 kaisaron tuna yen ton tɨ' ka'pɨ'sa' wai amʉ' esi'pʉ mɨrɨ, eke ton kuru rɨ, 20, 30 kiyaran e'to' airɨ tuna a'sinin.
Sises uya nin si, “Se ton wai amʉ' ipe'tɨpɨ'tɨ' tuna ke,” ta'pʉ mɨrɨ to' poitorʉ ton pɨ', mɨrɨpan pe'tɨpɨtʉ'pʉ to' uya ite'pi ton tepopɨ'se.
Mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ nin si, “Imatɨ' si, arɨ kon pa uta're'tɨn epuru piya',” ta'pʉ iya to' pɨ', mɨrɨpan kon uya arɨ'pʉ itena'.
Mɨrɨpan uya onpa'pʉ, tuna si enasa' waain pe. I'tu iya pʉra iyesi'pʉ nai winɨ iye'seposa' tukai' (e'tane to' poitorʉ ton uya rɨken i'tu'pʉ). Mɨrɨpan uya warawo', temari'masen kɨ'ma'pʉ,

mɨrɨpan uya, “Tanporon kon nɨ sa'ne wapiya wakʉ kuru waain ekannin nan ko, tanporo ikɨ'masa' kon uya nin si; ensika'sa' a'tai te'sen nʉ'kwɨ rɨ nin si ekamʉ to' uya mɨrɨ. E'tane wakʉ kuru rɨ enkurunpasa' auya man ko serɨ pʉ'kʉ pona!” ta'pʉ iya.
Serɨ si mɨrɨ ti'tuto' ipɨkɨrɨ ku'pɨtʉ tʉuya sara'tɨ'pʉ Sises uya Kena po, Kiyarari airɨ. Mɨrɨ si tʉmeruntɨrʉ enpoika'pʉ iya, mɨrɨpan apurɨ'pʉ ipoitorʉ ton uya.
Serɨ pata'pʉ pe, iu'tɨ'pʉ Ka'paneyan pona, tʉsan, takon non mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ tʉpoitorʉ ton pokon pe. Mɨrɨ yau to' uko'mamʉ'pʉ aka'ne' pe rɨ.
Sises Utɨ'pʉ Esuwerʉ Amʉ' Use'mato', Ɨpʉremato' Iwʉ' Ta'
Esuwerʉ amʉ' uya Itepoi Itɨ'pʉ Weyu Rʉ'pʉ ku'to' weyu e'seporo esi'pʉ, mɨrɨ pɨ' Sises utɨ'pʉ Surusiran pona.

Mɨrɨpan uya, Esuwerʉ amʉ' use'mato', ɨpʉremato' iwʉ' pʉ'kʉ tau, ka'pon amʉ' uya paka amʉ', karimeru amʉ', wako'wa amʉ' kʉrʉpo'poma eporo'pʉ, pʉrata ensimapɨ'nin nan nɨ ereutapɨ'sa' esi'pʉ tʉtepʉrʉʉi kon piyau'ne.
Si'na' amʉ' tʉkonekai' to' ari'po'pɨ'to' tʉuya ike pe, paka amʉ', karimeru amʉ' enpa'kanʉkʉ'pʉ iya; pʉrata ensimanin nan tepʉrʉʉi rawoipɨtʉ'pʉ iya, to' pʉrataai tʉrʉ'pɨtʉ'pʉ iya.
Mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ ka'pon amʉ' wako'wa amʉ' kʉrʉpo'pomanin nan pɨ', “To' akanʉ'tɨ' serɨ tapai, ukʉipʉnʉ iwʉ' kʉ'ku'tʉu kʉrʉpo'po pɨ' e'nɨ iwʉ' pe,” ta'pʉ iya.
Ipoitorʉ ton enu ya' iyee'pʉ iye'menukasa' itekare, “Papa, ɨiwʉ' kuru wenai uta'kwarʉka ukɨrɨ'nʉkʉ pɨ' man,”
tawon.
Esuwerʉ amʉ' epuru ton uyee'pʉ ekama'poi', “Ɨ'rɨ ɨi'tuto' ipɨkɨrɨ kupʉ auya, serɨ ku'to' auya ekamanin pe?” ta'pʉ to' uya.
Sises uya to' eikʉ'pʉ, “Se Papa ena' use'man nɨto', ɨpʉreman nɨto' iwʉ' a'morʉkatɨ', amɨto' pe uya osorʉwau wʉi yau,” ta'pʉ iya.
“Osorʉwau wʉi yau si serɨ amɨ auya kanan?” tukai' to' uya ekama'po'pʉ. “46 kaisa rɨ sa'ne wʉipiya amɨsa' rʉ'pʉ serɨ ko,” ta'pʉ to' uya.
E'tane use'man nɨto', ɨpʉreman nɨto' iwʉ' Sises nʉsauro'ai'ne' ipɨ' esi'pʉ mɨrɨ tʉmɨrɨ pun pɨ' rɨ nin.
Mɨrɨpan nin si e'mʉ'sa'kasa' a'tai terikʉ tʉpo, ipoitorʉ ton enu ya' iyee'pʉ mɨrɨ, serɨ ta'pʉ iya rʉ'pʉ, mɨrɨpan kon uya pena iye'menukasa' rʉ'pʉ itekare apurɨ'pʉ, mɨrɨ awonsi'kɨ Sises maimu rʉ'pʉ.
Sises esi koro'tau Surusiran po, To' Epoi Itɨ'pʉ Weyu Rʉ'pʉ kupʉ to' uya a'tai, tu'kan kon uya rɨ apurɨ'pʉ, eke Papa tʉrawasooi ti'tuto' ipɨkɨrɨ kupʉ iya ene tʉuya'nokon pɨ'.
E'tane Sises uya to' apurɨ'pʉ pen, apʉne pʉra mɨrɨ waraino kon tukai' to' i'tu tʉuya wenai.
Ɨnʉ' uya rɨ ipana'tɨto' pʉra iyesi ka'pon amʉ' pɨ', apʉne pʉra to' ewan nɨ i'tu iya wenai.
